source: Mord Hive v0.5. Imperial Prayers (p.046). Psychic Powers (p.019), Lesser Psy-Arcana (p.020) and other lists are added as their warbands are converted.
difficultyNote: Difficulty is the 2D6 the caster must equal or beat.

craftworldPowers.name: Craftworld Psychic Powers
craftworldPowers.notes: An Eldar Warlock uses the Craftworld Psychic Powers.

spells.name: Eldritch Storm
spells.effect: A psychic bolt strikes the closest enemy within 10" for a single Strength 5 hit (Strength 6 if the target wears any armour except helmets and shields).

spells.name: Empower
spells.effect: On a model within 6" (or himself), roll a D6: 1-2 +1 BS or +1 to hit in close combat, 3-4 +1 Toughness, 5-6 +1 Movement and Initiative. Lasts until the Warlock or model is Stunned/OOA; only one model at a time.

spells.name: Conceal
spells.effect: All Eldar within 6" (including the Warlock) in cover may immediately go into hiding, even if they ran or already shot a missile weapon.

spells.name: Fateful Divergence
spells.effect: The Warlock and any Eldar within 4" gain a 4+ save against Psychic Powers or Imperial Prayers. Remains until the Warlock is taken Out of Action.

spells.name: The Touch of Kaela Mensha Khaine
spells.effect: A single Eldar within 6" (or himself) is subject to Frenzy and gains +1 Strength. Lasts until Stunned/OOA; the Warlock must pass a Leadership roll at the start of each turn to keep it going. One model at a time.

spells.name: Quicken
spells.effect: A single Eldar within 6" (or himself) may make an additional 5" sprint move (counts as running; may not if it already fired a missile weapon, and may not charge with it).

cultRituals.name: Cult Rituals
cultRituals.notes: The Magus knows one randomly rolled Psychic Power from the Cult Rituals.

spells.name: The Horror
spells.effect: Range 6", the closest enemy (or a base-contact model if in combat) is immediately stunned; if it cannot be stunned it is knocked down instead.

spells.name: Gout of Bio-Plasma
spells.effect: Range 8", D3 S5 hits on the first model in its path. Afterwards the Magus rolls on the Injury table for himself (treat 'out of action' as stunned).

spells.name: Mass Hypnosis
spells.effect: Range 12", the closest enemy. Roll a D6 + Magus's Leadership vs a D6 + the target's Leadership; if the Magus wins he controls the model until it passes a Leadership test in its own recovery phase (it may attack its own side but not the Magus's warband, and can't commit suicide).

spells.name: His Arrival!
spells.effect: The Magus causes fear in his enemies for the duration of the battle.

spells.name: Into the Shadows
spells.effect: The Magus may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact (counts as charging). If he engages a fleeing enemy he scores one automatic hit and the opponent flees again if it survives.

spells.name: Mental Onslaught
spells.effect: The Magus brings his force of will to bear against all that come too close to him. TODO: full effect text was truncated in the PDF extraction (p.082) - verify against the ruleset.

waaaghPowers.name: Waaagh! Psychic Powers
waaaghPowers.notes: Howling prayers to the Ork gods Gork and Mork, used by Ork Wyrd Boyz.

spells.name: Led'z Go
spells.effect: Any Ork or Grot within 4" of the Wyrd Boy automatically strikes first in hand-to-hand combat, regardless of other circumstances. Lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action.

spells.name: Oi! Gerroff!
spells.effect: Range 8". Moves one enemy model D6" directly away from the Wyrd Boy; if it collides with a model or building both suffer 1 S3 hit. May not target models in hand-to-hand combat.

spells.name: Zzap!
spells.effect: Range 12". Causes D3 S4 hits on the closest enemy target, with no armour saves.

spells.name: Fooled Ya!
spells.effect: No enemy may charge the Wyrd Boy during their next turn. If engaged in hand-to-hand combat he may immediately move 4" away.

spells.name: Choppa
spells.effect: An ectoplasmic choppa: counts as a normal choppa with +2 Strength and gives +1 Attack. Lasts until the Wyrd Boy suffers a wound.

spells.name: Fire of Gork (or possibly Mork)
spells.effect: Range 12". Two bolts each cause D3 S3 hits, fired both at the closest enemy or split between the two closest.

nurgleRituals.name: Nurgle Rituals
nurgleRituals.notes: The Plague Abbot is a Psyker and uses the Rituals of Nurgle.

spells.name: Daemonic Vigour
spells.effect: Any Plague Bearers within 8" of the Plague Abbot increase their Daemonic Aura save from 5+ to 4+ until the beginning of their next turn.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.effect: Range 8", a single enemy warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No armour saves.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.effect: Range 6", affects all living creatures friend or foe: each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.effect: All enemy models within 12" of the Plague Abbot suffer a Strength 3 hit. No armour saves.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.effect: The Plague Abbot gains a 2+ armour save (replacing any normal save) until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

spells.name: Arise ye Faithful!
spells.effect: One Blight Victim that went out of action during the last hand-to-hand or Shooting phase returns to battle within 6" of the Plague Abbot (not straight into hand-to-hand combat).

imperialPrayers.name: Imperial Prayers
imperialPrayers.notes: An Ecclesiastic Priest may use prayers while in armour. Prayers are not psychic powers, so protection against psychic powers does not affect them.

spells.name: Hammer of the Emperor
spells.effect: The wielder gains +2 Strength in hand-to-hand combat and all hits he inflicts cause double damage (e.g. 2 wounds instead of 1). Test each combat phase he wants to use the Hammer.

spells.name: Hearts of Steel
spells.effect: Allied warriors within 8" become immune to Fear and All Alone tests, and the whole warband gains +1 to Rout tests. Lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or put out of action; not cumulative if recast.

spells.name: Soulfire
spells.effect: All enemy models within 4" suffer a Strength 3 hit with no armour saves. Chaos models in range suffer a Strength 5 hit instead.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.effect: The Priest is immune to all psychic powers. Roll at the start of each turn in the recovery phase; on a 1 or 2 the shield disappears.

spells.name: Healing Hand
spells.effect: One model within 2" (including himself) is restored to full Wounds. Friendly models within 2" that are stunned or knocked down immediately stand and continue fighting.

spells.name: Armour of Righteousness
spells.effect: The Priest gains a 2+ armour save (replacing his normal save) and causes fear (and is therefore immune to fear himself).

lesserPsyArcana.name: Lesser Psy-Arcana
lesserPsyArcana.notes: Psykers, or even the slightly warp attuned can sometimes make use of some of these lesser Psy-Arcana. While these abilities pale in comparison to what trained Psykers may have access to, it is still no laughing matter to attempt these, or be on the receiving end.

spells.name: Warp-Fire
spells.effect: The Psyker clicks psychoreactive sparks into life, before flinging them at their opponent. The warp-fire has a range of 18" and causes one Strength 4 hit. It strikes the first model in its path. Armour saves are taken as normal.

spells.name: Levitation
spells.effect: The Psyker levitates into the air, floating to wherever they will. The psyker may immediately move anywhere within 12", including into base contact with an enemy, in which case he counts as charging. If he engages a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase he will score 1 automatic hit and then his opponent will flee again (if he survives).

spells.name: Glimpse the Void
spells.effect: The Psyker allows an unlucky opponent to see the merest glimpse of the warp. A single model within 12" of the psyker must pass a Leadership test or flee 2D6" directly away from him. If he flees, he must test at the start of each of his own movement phases and will continue to flee until he passes a test. Note that this power does not affect any model immune to fear.

spells.name: Psy-Resonant Shards
spells.effect: The Psyker summons up a handful of psy-resonant warp shards to encircle them, to be thrown at opponents. Unlike other powers, this cannot be manifested whilst in hand-to-hand combat. The power summons D6+2 shards which the psyker can use to shoot against one enemy model. The shards have a range of 24". Use the psyker's own Ballistic Skill to determine whether he hits or not, but ignore movement, range and cover penalties. The shards cause one S3 hit each.

spells.name: Tricksters Luck
spells.effect: The Psyker taps into some skein of fate within the immaterium. The psyker may re-roll all his failed dice rolls, though the second results stand. The effect lasts until the beginning of his own next turn.

spells.name: Obsidian Sword
spells.effect: The psyker pulls forth a sword from the ether. It is the most pure black, even light failing to escape its aura. The sword gives the psyker +1 Attack, +2 Strength and +2 Weapon Skill. Take a Leadership test at the beginning of each of the psyker's own turns. If the test fails, the sword disappears.
